description_sq:
Vila ka nje siperfaqe totale prej 234 m2 + 46 m2 + 47 m2 veranda dhe siperfaqe trualli 444 m2.
E projektuar perball malit piktoresk te Dajit, Rezidenca po ndërtohet si nje kompleks unik qe do te ofrojë standartin me te larte te jeteses ne Tirane.
Rezidenca eshte ne harmonite plote me peisazhin e zones, larg zhurmave te qytetit, dhe ofron nje ambjent qetèsues per banoret. Arkitektura unike dhe bashkëkohore ështè e orientuar shumë mire me dritën e diellit dhe konturet e tokes natyrale, duke ofruar nje fushëpamje te gjere te malit te Dajtit nga cdo vilë.
Vendndodhia e kompleksit ofron akses direkt me unazen e madhe te Tiranes, qëndrën tregètare TEG, supermarkete , restorante, por edhe me parqet natyrore të rrethinave te qytetit per dashamiresit e sporteve ne natyrë.
Duke gëne se vendi yne ndodhet ne zone me aktivitet sizmik, rezidenca eshte projektuar ne menyre rigoroze sipas standartit te ndertimit 'Eurocode', per te qënë njè nga ndertimet me cilèsine me te larte ne zonen e Farkes.
Projekti eshte konceptuar ge pervec pamieve panoramike tè siguroje edhe privatèsine e cdo vile; ne nje kompleks ku do te ofrohet vendroje dhe siguri maksimale 24 ore.
description_en: The villa has a total area of ​​234 m2 + 46 m2 + 47 m2 veranda and a plot area of ​​444 m2. Designed in front of the picturesque mountain of Dajit, the Residence is being built as a unique complex that will offer the highest standard of living in Tirana. The residence is in full harmony with the landscape of the area, away from the noises of the city, and offers a calming environment for the residents. The unique and contemporary architecture is very well oriented to the sunlight and the contours of the natural land, offering a wide view of Dajti mountain from every villa. The location of the complex offers direct access to the big ring of Tirana, the TEG shopping center, supermarkets, restaurants, but also to the natural parks of the city's surroundings for lovers of outdoor sports. Considering that our country is located in an area with seismic activity, the residence has been rigorously designed according to the Eurocode construction standard, to be one of the highest quality buildings in the Farka area. The project is designed to ensure, in addition to panoramic views, the privacy of each villa; in a complex where accommodation and maximum 24-hour security will be offered.
